BURHAN:v4p426/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p426/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p426/r1.claim: The phrase بعضهم من بعض expresses a shared relation: believers are allies, while the comparison with 3:34 evokes common lineage; the cited disbelievers instead disavow one another.

TABATABAI:11:36-49#26/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:11:36-49#26/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:11:36-49#26/r4.claim: All strength and honor belong to God, so Islam permits reverence for others only when it leads back to God, as in honoring the Messenger, believers, and divine signs.
TABATABAI:11:36-49#26/r4.anchor: فلا خضوع في الإسلام لأحد دون الله إلا ما يرجع إليه تعالى ويقصد به

STUDYQURAN:9:71/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r1.claim: The description of believers mirrors the preceding description of hypocrites.
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r1.anchor: This verse in a sense mirrors the description of the hypocrites in v. 67

STUDYQURAN:9:71/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r2.claim: The discussion of enjoining right and forbidding wrong is cross-referenced to 3:104.
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r2.anchor: On enjoining right and forbidding wrong, see 3:104c

STUDYQURAN:9:71/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r3.claim: Protectors of one another also means friends or allies of one another.
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r3.anchor: Protectors of one another also means friends or allies of one another

STUDYQURAN:9:71/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r4.claim: The verse gives women the same spiritual and social obligations as men, including moral authority and protection.
STUDYQURAN:9:71/r4.anchor: it places upon them the same spiritual and social obligations placed on men, including moral authority and protection

TAB-FULL:v11p291/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p291/r5.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v11p291/r5.claim: Mujāhid says the final three verses of al-Anfāl describe the earlier inheritance-based allegiance between Muslim emigrants and Helpers, which was then abrogated by the final verse on kinship.
TAB-FULL:v11p291/r5.anchor: عن مجاهد، قال: " الثلاث الآيات خواتيم الأنفال

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r1.claim: Believing men and women are those who affirm God, His Messenger, and the signs of His Book; they support and help one another.
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r1.anchor: فإن صفتهم أن بعضهم أنصار بعض وأعوانهم

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r2.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r2.claim: Enjoining right means urging people to believe in God, His Messenger, and the revelation He sent.

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r4.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r4.claim: They give the obligatory zakat to those entitled to receive it.

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r5.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r5.claim: They obey God and His Messenger by carrying out their commands and avoiding what they forbid.
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r5.anchor: فيأتمرون لأمر الله ورسوله وينتهون عما نهيناهم عنه

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r6.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r6.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r6.claim: God will rescue people with these qualities from punishment and admit them to Paradise, unlike hypocrites who command evil and withhold God’s due.

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r7.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r7.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r7.claim: God is mighty in punishing the disobedient, with no one able to prevent or defend against Him, and wise in all His actions and punishments.
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r7.anchor: لا يمنعه من الانتقام منه مانع ولا ينصره

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r8.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r8.speaker: أبو العالية
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r8.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya says that throughout the Quran, enjoining right means calling people from associating partners to Islam, while forbidding wrong means forbidding worship of idols and devils.
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r8.anchor: عن أبي العالية، قال: " كل ما ذكره الله في القرآن

TAB-FULL:v11p556/r9.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r9.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r9.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the prayer as the five daily prayers.
TAB-FULL:v11p556/r9.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: " {يقيمون الصلاة} [التوبة: 71] قال: الصلوات الخمس

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r1.claim: Believers, despite differences of number and gender, form one unified community; therefore they mutually assume responsibility for and manage one another's affairs.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r1.anchor: ليدل بذلك على أنهم مع كثرتهم وتفرقهم من حيث العدد ومن الذكورة والأنوثة ذوو كينونة واحدة

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r2.claim: Because this mutual guardianship extends throughout the community, believers enjoin right and forbid wrong among one another as well.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r2.anchor: فلولاية بعض المجتمع على بعض ولاية سارية في جميع الابعاض دخل في تصديقهم الأمر بالمعروف

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r3.claim: Prayer and zakat are the two firm pillars of the law: prayer links God and creation through worship, while zakat links people through social dealings.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r3.anchor: فالصلاة ركن العبادات التي هي الرابطة بين الله وبين خلقه، والزكاة في المعاملات التي هي رابطة بين الناس

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r4.claim: Obedience to God gathers all divine legal rulings; obedience to the Messenger gathers his authoritative rulings for governing and reforming the community, including campaigns, judgments, and legal penalties.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r4.anchor: فجمع في إطاعة الله جميع الأحكام الشرعية الإلهية وجمع في إطاعة رسوله جميع الأحكام الولائية

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r5.claim: In another respect, obeying God's revealed laws is included in obeying the Messenger, who proclaims truth and calls people to the fundamentals and branches of religion.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r5.anchor: على أن إطاعة شرائع الله النازلة من السماء من جهة أخرى منطوية في إطاعة الرسول

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r6.claim: The promise reports God's decree that his mercy encompasses people described by these qualities and mirrors the hypocrites' being forgotten by God.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r6.anchor: وكأن في هذه الجملة محاذاة لما سرد في المنافقين من قوله تعالى { نسوا الله فنسيهم }

TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r7.claim: God's might cannot obstruct his mercy, and his wisdom entails no defect, weakness, or arbitrary judgment; these attributes explain the promised mercy.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#6/r7.anchor: فلا مانع من رحمته لعزته، ولا اختلال أو وهنا وجزافا في حكمته

TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r8.speaker: أبو عبد الله عليه السلام
TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r8.claim: Abu Abd Allah permits Safwan to transport a Muslim woman he knows when she has no mahram, saying a believer is a mahram for a believing woman, and recites this verse.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r8.anchor: عن صفوان بن مهران قال قلت لأبي عبد الله عليه السلام تأتيني المرأة المسلمة قد عرفتني بعملي

TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r9.claim: The author notes that al-Ayyashi also transmits the Safwan al-Jammal report from Abu Abd Allah.
TABATABAI:9:64-74#8/r9.anchor: أقول ورواه العياشي في تفسيره عن صفوان الجمال عنه عليه السلام

TABRISI:9:71-72/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r1.claim: ʿAdn, residence, and eternity are synonymous; al-Aʿsha's poem uses ʿadana in the sense of remaining or settling.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r1.anchor: العدن والإقامة والخلود نظائر ومنه المعدن

TABRISI:9:71-72/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r2.claim: Ridwan is the verbal noun of radiya, while jihad means undertaking a difficult matter and derives from jahd.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r2.anchor: والرضوان مصدر رضي يرضى رضى ورضوانا والجهاد ممارسة الأمر الشاق وأصله من الجهد

TABRISI:9:71-72/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r3.claim: After describing the hypocrites' bad traits, the passage describes believers by their opposite qualities, linking the discussion through contrast.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r3.anchor: لما ذكر الله تعالى المنافقين ووصفهم بقبيح خصالهم اقتضت الحكمة أن يذكر المؤمنين ويصفهم بضد أوصافهم

TABRISI:9:71-72/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r4.claim: Believers are mutual helpers and allies, each obliged to support the other; even a wife prepares her husband's journey and protects his absence, and together they stand as one against others.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r4.anchor: أي بعضهم أنصار بعض يلزم كل واحد منهم نصرة صاحبه وموالاته حتى أن المرأة تهيئ أسباب السفر لزوجها

TABRISI:9:71-72/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r5.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r5.claim: Maʿruf is what God obliges or recommends people to do by reason or revealed law.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r5.anchor: وهو ما أوجب الله فعله أو رغب فيه عقلا أو شرعا

TABRISI:9:71-72/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r6.claim: Munkar is what God forbids or discourages by reason or revealed law.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r6.anchor: وهو ما نهى الله عن فعله وزهد فيه عقلا أو شرعا

TABRISI:9:71-72/r7.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r7.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r7.claim: They persist in prayer, pay zakat from their wealth, direct it where God ordered, and obey and follow the will and approval of God and His Messenger.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r7.anchor: يداومون على فعل الصلاة وإخراج الزكاة من أموالهم ووضعها حيث أمر الله تعالى بوضعها فيه

TABRISI:9:71-72/r8.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r8.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r8.claim: God will have mercy on such believers in the afterlife; He is mighty and wise, able to give mercy or punishment and to place each appropriately.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r8.anchor: أي الذين هذه صفتهم يرحمهم الله في الآخرة

TABRISI:9:71-72/r9.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:9:71-72/r9.speaker: author
TABRISI:9:71-72/r9.claim: The verse indicates that enjoining right and forbidding wrong are individual obligations, since it attributes them to all believers without restricting them to a particular group.
TABRISI:9:71-72/r9.anchor: وفي الآية دلالة على أن الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر من فروض الأعيان لأنه جعلهما من صفات جميع المؤمنين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r1.claim: Believers are allies in mercy and love.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن # عباس: (يريد في الرحمة والمحبة)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r2.speaker: أبو علي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r2.claim: Believers support and ally with one another, remain united rather than disavowing one another, and share one word.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r2.anchor: قال أبو علي: (المعنى فيه أن بعضهم يوالي بعضا ولا يبرأ بعضهم من بعض

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r3.speaker: أبو علي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r3.claim: He connects enmity as the opposite of alliance to the root sense of crossing beyond something.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r3.anchor: ألا ترى أن العداوة من عدا الشيء: إذا جاوزه

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r4.claim: The good they command is the confession that there is no god but God.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r4.anchor: قال ابن عباس: (بأنه لا إله إلا الله)

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r5.claim: The wrong they forbid is associating partners with God.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r5.anchor: قال ابن عباس: (بأنه لا إله إلا الله) (4) {وينهون عن المنكر} يريد: عن الشرك بالله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r6.claim: Throughout the Quran, commanding right means calling people to Islam, and forbidding wrong means forbidding idol worship.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r6.anchor: قال أبو العالية: (كل ما ذكر الله في كتابه من الأمر بالمعروف فهو الدعاء إلى الإسلام

WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r7.speaker: بعض أهل المعاني
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r7.claim: Hypocrites are affiliated only through shared hypocrisy and lack believers' mutual loyalty because their hearts differ; believers instead have loving, compassionate unity.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v10p547#2/r7.anchor: وقال بعض أهل المعاني: [ذكر الله المنافقين] (6)، فقال: {بعضهم من بعض} وذكر المؤمنين

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r11.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r11.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r11.claim: Believing men and women are allies through compassion and love.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r12.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r12.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r12.claim: Enjoining good means calling people to Islam.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r13.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r13.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:9:69-71/r13.claim: Forbidding wrong means forbidding association of others with God.

ELMALILI:9:71-72/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:9:71-72/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:9:71-72/r1.claim: Elmalılı renders the mutual awliyāʾ relation as male and female believers being one another's walīs or protectors.
ELMALILI:9:71-72/r1.anchor: Erkek, dişi bütün mü’minler ise birbirlerinin velîleridirler

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:61/r15.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:61/r15.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:61/r15.claim: The account contrasts the hypocrites' character and fate in verses 67–68 with the believers' character and happy outcome in verses 71–72.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:61/r15.anchor: 67. âyette münafık karakterine ve 68. âyette münafıkların acı âkıbetlerine değinildiği gibi, 71. âyette mümin karakterine ve 72. âyette de onların mutlu sonlarına işaret edilerek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r1.claim: Men and women are separately named in 9:71, as in 9:67, because each verse describes the shared traits of both sexes in its group.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r1.anchor: Münafıklardan söz edilirken 67. âyette erkeğiyle kadınıyla münafık karakterine işaret edilmek üzere her iki cins ayrı ayrı zikredilmişti. 71. âyette de müminlerin ortak niteliklerine değinildiğinden erkek ve kadınları ayrı ayrı anılmıştır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r2.speaker: Râzî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r2.claim: Razi's comparison says hypocrites promote evil and restrain good, whereas sincere believers encourage good and try to turn people away from evil.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r2.anchor: İki yüzlü davranan kimselere hâkim olan özellik, kötülükleri körükleyip iyilikten alıkoymak iken yürekten inananların temel vasfı iyiliği özendirmek, kötülükten vazgeçirmeye çalışmaktır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r3.claim: Hypocrites are tight-fisted in God's cause, while believers pay zakat, give generously beyond it, and regret being unable to give more.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r3.anchor: Münafıklar Allah yolunda harcamada eli sıkı davranırken müminler zekâtlarını verirler ve ayrıca cömertçe gönüllü bağışlarda bulunurlar

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r4.claim: Hypocrites approach prayer reluctantly, while believers pray sincerely, with an inner desire and sense of duty.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r4.anchor: Münafıklar namaza üşenerek gelirler, müminler ise namazlarını bir kulluk vecîbesi sayarak içten gelen bir istekle kılarlar

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r5.claim: When called to fight for God, hypocrites evade with excuses, but believers give their lives and wealth and answer without faltering.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r5.anchor: Allah yolunda savaşmak gerektiğinde münafıklar türlü mazeretlerle yan çizmeye çalışırlar, müminler ise canlarını ve mallarını esirgemeden böyle bir çağrıya koşarlar

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r6.claim: Hypocrites disregard God and His message and mock believers, while believers obey God and His Messenger fully.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r6.anchor: Münafıklar Allah’ı ve O’nun mesajını umursamazlar, O’na ve vaad ettiklerine candan inanan müminlerle alay ederler, müminler ise Allah ve resulüne mutlak itaat gösterirler

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r7.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r7.claim: Hypocrites who die without overcoming disbelief enter eternal Hell; believers receive endless Paradise blessings and, above all, happiness in God's pleasure.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r7.anchor: Allah, –içlerindeki inkârcılığı yenemeden ömürlerini tamamlayan– münafıkları ebedî olarak kalacakları cehenneme atacak, müminlere de hiç bitmeyen cennet nimetlerinin

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r8.claim: For the meaning of evliyā in 9:71, the commentary directs readers to related discussions in several other Qur'anic passages.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:9:71/r8.anchor: 71. âyette geçen evliyâ kelimesi için bk.

QUSHAYRI:v1p432/r11.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v1p432/r11.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v1p432/r11.claim: The faithful help one another obey, counsel one another to avoid prohibitions, love and accompany each other for God, oppose for God, and relinquish personal interests for His sake.
QUSHAYRI:v1p432/r11.anchor: يعين بعضهم بعضا على الطاعات ، ويتواصون بينهم بترك المحظورات ؛ فتحابهم في الله

BURHAN:v3p356/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p356/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p356/r1.claim: Plural forms conventionally associated with a small count can denote abundance; the Qur'an supplies many examples, including الصابرين والصادقين and المؤمنين والمؤمنات.
BURHAN:v3p356/r1.anchor: وقوله تعالى ﴿ من كل الثمرات ﴾ 2 ﴿ إن تبدوا الصدقات ﴾ 3 ﴿ الصابرين والصادقين ﴾ 4 الآية

BURHAN:v1p90/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p90/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p90/r3.claim: The promise that God will show mercy to believing men and women, followed by العزيز الحكيم, is offered as a parallel to the preceding explanation of divine attributes.
BURHAN:v1p90/r3.anchor: ونظير هذه الآية قوله تعالى فى سورة براءة ﴿ أولئك سيرحمهم الله إن الله عزيز حكيم ﴾

BURHAN:v2p418/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p418/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
BURHAN:v2p418/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhshari says س guarantees the promised mercy, just as it guarantees a delayed threat; combining س and سوف marks certain but delayed giving in the promise to the Prophet.
BURHAN:v2p418/r4.anchor: فقال في قوله تعالى ﴿ أولئك سيرحمهم الله ﴾ السين تفيد وجود الرحمة لا محالة فهي تؤكد الوعد

BURHAN:v2p418/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p418/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p418/r5.claim: Critics object that the verb, not س, conveys the existence of mercy, and that inevitability is not actually signaled by the particle.
BURHAN:v2p418/r5.anchor: وقد اعترض عليه بان وجود الرحمة مستفاد من الفعل لا من السين وبان الوجوب المشار اليه

BURHAN:v2p418/r6.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p418/r6.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p418/r6.claim: One reply says س normally marks occurrence with delay, so in a glad tiding without a delay focus it emphasizes realization; the author notes that context may do this work instead.
BURHAN:v2p418/r6.anchor: ان السين موضوعة للدلالة على الوقوع مع التاخر فاذا كان المقام ليس مقام تأخير

BURHAN:v2p418/r7.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p418/r7.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p418/r7.claim: A second reply says س conveys the promise or threat and its delayed course, effectively reporting twice and making the outcome more assured.
BURHAN:v2p418/r7.anchor: ان السين يحصل بها ترتيب الفائدة لانها تفيد امرين الوعيد والاحبار بطرقة

BURHAN:v2p418/r8.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p418/r8.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p418/r8.claim: The emphatic nūn with shadda is like repeating a verb three times, while the light nūn is like repeating it twice.
BURHAN:v2p418/r8.anchor: ثالثا النون الشديدة وهي بمنزلة ذكر الفعل ثلاث مرات وبالخفيفة فهي بمنزلة ذكره مرتين

SULAMI:v1p280#2/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p280#2/r1.speaker: أبو عثمان
SULAMI:v1p280#2/r1.claim: Abu Uthman says believers support one another in worship, spur one another to it, and strengthen one another on the path to salvation; he cites the Prophet's comparisons of believers to a building and to one body.
SULAMI:v1p280#2/r1.anchor: قال أبو عثمان : المؤمنون أيضا يتعاونون على العبادة

SULAMI:v1p280#2/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v1p280#2/r2.speaker: أبو بكر الوراق
SULAMI:v1p280#2/r2.claim: Abu Bakr al-Warraq says a believer naturally and instinctively befriends another believer.
SULAMI:v1p280#2/r2.anchor: قال أبو بكر الوراق : المؤمن يوالي المؤمن طبعا وسجية

ITQAN:v2p474#2/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p474#2/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p474#2/r5.claim: In a promise or threat, سـ reinforces certainty even if fulfillment is delayed; in 9:71 it assures that God will show mercy, as it can reinforce a threat of revenge.
ITQAN:v2p474#2/r5.anchor: في قوله ﴿ أولئك سيرحمهم الله ﴾ السين مفيدة وجود الرحمة لا محالة فهي تؤكد الوعد كما تؤكد الوعيد

ITQAN:v3p307/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p307/r6.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p307/r6.claim: Hypocrites share doubt and hypocrisy but lack common open allegiance; believers and declared unbelievers aid one another, unlike the hypocrites whose hearts are divided.
ITQAN:v3p307/r6.anchor: لأن المنافقين ليسوا متناصرين على دين معين وشريعة ظاهرة

ITQAN:v3p275/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p275/r2.speaker: author
ITQAN:v3p275/r2.claim: These parallel endings show that mercy or a plea for forgiveness can fittingly end with “Mighty, Wise,” since God’s mercy and pardon are sovereign and wise.
ITQAN:v3p275/r2.anchor: ونظير ذلك قوله في سورة التوبة

TUSTARI:9:71/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:9:71/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:9:71/r1.claim: Showing loyalty to fellow believers means refraining from harming them.
TUSTARI:9:71/r1.anchor: موالاته مع المؤمنين كف الأذى عنهم

TUSTARI:9:71/r2.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:9:71/r2.speaker: author
TUSTARI:9:71/r2.claim: A servant reaches the reality of faith by being like the earth to God's servants: they live on it and benefit from it.
TUSTARI:9:71/r2.anchor: واعلموا أن العبد لا يبلغ حقيقة الإيمان حتى يكون لعباد الله كالأرض، إذ هم عليها

TUSTARI:9:71/r3.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:9:71/r3.speaker: author
TUSTARI:9:71/r3.claim: The seven foundations are adherence to God's Book, following His Messenger, lawful food, refraining from harm, avoiding sins, repentance, and fulfilling people's rights.
TUSTARI:9:71/r3.anchor: الأصول عندنا سبع: التمسك بكتاب الله، والاقتداء برسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وأكل الحلال

DAMGHANI:v1p498/r1.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p498/r1.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p498/r1.claim: The believers being awliyāʾ of one another means that they are allies in religion.
DAMGHANI:v1p498/r1.anchor: وقال تعالى في سورة التوبة والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض يعني في الدين

DAMGHANI:v1p37/r4.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p37/r4.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p37/r4.claim: One gloss makes commanding right mean affirming God’s oneness and forbidding wrong mean rejecting shirk.
DAMGHANI:v1p37/r4.anchor: الأمر بالمعروف يعني التوحيد . والنهي عن المنكر يعني الشرك بالله

DAMGHANI:v1p37/r5.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p37/r5.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p37/r5.claim: A second gloss makes commanding right mean following the Prophet and forbidding wrong mean denying him, as in 3:113.
DAMGHANI:v1p37/r5.anchor: الثاني : الأمر بالمعروف إتباع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم , والنهي عن المنكر

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p574/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p574/r3.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p574/r3.claim: Maʿruf means monotheism in the command to enjoin it in 9:71 and 31:17; the source also groups 9:112.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p574/r3.anchor: وذكر أهل التفسير أن المعروف في القرآن على ثمانية أوجه : أحدها : التوحيد

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r1.claim: Munkar derives from nakira; in religious law it means prohibited acts and is the opposite of maʿrūf.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r1.anchor: المنكر : اسم مشتق من النكرة . وهو في الشريعة عبارة عن ارتكاب محظورات الشرع

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r2.claim: Nakira means not knowing or recognizing; tanakkara means changing from a pleasant state to another.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r2.anchor: ويقال : نكرت الشيء وأنكرته . والتنكر : التنقل عن حال تسر إلى أخرى

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p544/r4.claim: Munkar can mean denial of the Prophet.

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p398/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p398/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p398/r1.claim: The source counts enjoining right and forbidding wrong as a sense of ṣalāḥ, illustrated by Hūd's reformers.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p398/r1.anchor: والتاسع : الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر . ومنه قوله تعالى في هود

SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r1.claim: Believers are mutual allies, unlike the hypocrites, of whom the parallel verse says only بعضهم من بعض because there is no mutual allegiance among them.
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r1.anchor: إذ لا ولاية بين المنافقين. وقوله " يأمرون " كما تقدم في نظيره

SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r2.claim: The syntax of يأمرون is as in the parallel clause in 9:67: it has no syntactic position and explains the preceding relation.
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r2.anchor: وقوله " يأمرون " كما تقدم في نظيره

SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r3.claim: The sīn marks future time because the special mercy meant here is reserved for the Hereafter.
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r3.anchor: والسين في " سيرحمهم الله " للاستقبال، إذ المراد رحمة خاصة وهي ما خبأه لهم في الآخرة

SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī claims the future marker conveys the certainty of mercy and intensifies promise and threat, as in سأنتقم منك.
SAMIN-DURR:9:71/r4.anchor: وادعى الزمخشري أنها تفيد وجوب الرحمة وتوكيد الوعيد والوعيد نحو: سأنتقم منك.

ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r1.claim: Asad notes an alternative rendering of the believers' awliya' as “protectors” or “friends and protectors” of one another.
ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r1.anchor: Or: "are the protectors [or "friends and protectors"] of one another".

ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r2.claim: Asad prefers the primary sense “near” or “close” to one another because believers are contrasted with hypocrites described as all alike in 9:67.
ASAD-NOTES:9:71#n99/r2.anchor: preferable to render the term wali (of which awliya' is the plural) in its primary meaning of being "near" or "close" to one another

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p79/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p79/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p79/r1.claim: The Qur'an does not use a present-tense form of جاء; it uses أتى for the corresponding present meaning, so present forms are not part of the comparison.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r5.claim: After listing the hypocrites' evil qualities, the passage turns to believing men and women and contrasts “some of others” with “some are guardians of others.”
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r5.anchor: لما ذكر المنافقين والمنافقات وما هم عليه من الأوصاف القبيحة والأعمال الفاسدة، ذكر المؤمنين والمؤمنات

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r6.speaker: ابن عطية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya says the hypocrites have no guardianship or intercession among themselves and do not pray for one another; this verse means guardianship for God's sake.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r6.anchor: قال ابن عطية: إذ لا ولاية بين المنافقين ولا شفاعة لهم، ولا يدعو بعضهم لبعض

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r7.speaker: أبو عبد الله الرازي
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r7.claim: Al-Rāzī says followers' hypocrisy stems from imitation, nature, and habit, while believers' shared outlook comes from reasoning, divine aid, and guidance; walāya opposes enmity.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r7.anchor: وقال أبو عبد الله الرازي: بعضهم من بعض يدل على أن نفاق الأتباع وكفرهم حصل بسبب التقليد لأولئك الأكابر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r8.claim: The listed acts explain guardianship and distinguish believers from hypocrites: believers enjoin right, forbid wrong, pray, give alms, fight, and obey God and His Messenger.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r8.anchor: ولما وصف المؤمنين بكون بعضهم أولياء بعض ذكر بعده ما يجري كالتفسير والشرح له، وهي الخمسة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r9.speaker: أبو العالية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r9.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya says Quranic commands to right mean calling from polytheism to Islam.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r9.anchor: وقال أبو العالية: كل ما ذكره الله في القرآن من الأمر بالمعروف فهو دعاء من الشرك إلى الإسلام

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r10.speaker: أبو العالية
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r10.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya says prohibitions of wrong mean forbidding worship of idols and devils.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r10.anchor: وما ذكر من النهي عن المنكر فهو النهي عن عبادة الأصنام والشياطين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r11.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies establishing prayer here with the five prescribed prayers.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v5p459/r11.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: ويقيمون الصلاة هي الصلوات الخمس

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r1.claim: The passage describes believers' good state now and in the hereafter after describing their opponents' state in this life and the next.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r1.anchor: بيان لحسن حال المؤمنين والمؤمنات حالا ومآلا بعد بيان حال أضدادهم عاجلا وآجلا

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r2.claim: Their mutual guardianship contrasts with the earlier description of hypocrites as one another's kind; the wording changes to convey mutual support and solidarity.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r2.anchor: يقابل قوله تعالى فيما مر : ( بعضهم من بعض ) وتغيير الأسلوب للإشارة إلى تناصرهم وتعاضدهم

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r3.claim: Enjoining good and forbidding wrong explicitly reverses the hypocrites' behavior; the discussion of good and wrong is the same as above.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r3.anchor: ظاهر المقابلة ( ليأمرون بالمنكر ) الخ الكلام في المنكر والمعروف معروف

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r4.claim: Establishing prayer contrasts with the hypocrites' forgetting God, and adds special praise of believers.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r4.anchor: وقيل : هو في مقابلة ( نسوا الله ) وقوله سبحانه : ( ويقيمون الصلاة ) زيادة مدح

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r5.claim: Paying zakat reverses the hypocrites' grasping their hands shut.

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r6.claim: They obey God and His Messenger in all matters, in contrast to the hypocrites' complete rebellion; another view makes this specifically contrast their forgetting God.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r6.anchor: أي في سائر الأمور في مقابلة وصف المنافقين بكمال الفسق والخروج عن الطاعة

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r7.claim: God's promised mercy contrasts with His withholding grace from hypocrites; another interpretation contrasts it with their being called rebellious, since the righteous are the pious and recipients of mercy.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r7.anchor: في مقابلة ( فنسيهم ) المفسر بمنع لطفه ورحمته سبحانه

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r8.claim: The demonstrative refers to the believers and women believers characterized by the preceding excellent qualities; its distant form carries the emphasis discussed earlier.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r8.anchor: والإشارة إلى المؤمنين والمؤمنات باعتبار اتصافهم بما سلف من الصفات الجليلة

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r9.speaker: الزمخشري
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r9.claim: Al-Zamakhshari and others say the future particle strengthens the promise of mercy.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r9.anchor: على ما قال الزمخشري وتبعه غير واحد لتأكيد الوعد

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r10.speaker: صاحب التقريب
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r10.claim: The author of al-Taqrib argues that the future particle emphasizes whatever follows because affirmation with sa- contrasts with negation by lan, whether the result is promise, threat, or something else.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r10.anchor: ووجه ذلك بأن السين في الإثبات في مقابلة لن في النفي فتكون بهذا الاعتبار تأكيدا لما دخلت عليه

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r11.speaker: ابن حجر
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r11.claim: Ibn Hajar rejects the claim that sa- itself guarantees the promised outcome: certainty comes from context, and he says the claim serves al-Zamakhshari's mistaken doctrine that reward is necessary.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r11.anchor: وقال العلامة ابن حجر : ما زعمه الزمخشري من أن السين تفيد القطع بمدخولها مردود

ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r12.speaker: ابن قاسم
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r12.claim: Ibn Qasim counters Ibn Hajar's criticism: a transmitted point cannot be dismissed by that argument, and accusing the imams of inattention arises from a desire to object.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p135/r12.anchor: وتعقبه الفهامة ابن قاسم بأن هذا لا وجه له لأنه أمر نقلي لا يدفعه ما ذكر

ALUSI-FULL:v10p136/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v10p136/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v10p136/r1.claim: God is mighty, able to do anything and never prevented from willing it, and wise, placing things where they belong, including reward and punishment; this grounds the promised mercy.
ALUSI-FULL:v10p136/r1.anchor: يضع الأشياء مواضعها ومن ذلك النعمة والنقمة والجملة تعليل للوعد

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r11.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r11.claim: Believing men and women are allies through religion, unity of purpose, mutual aid, and support.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r11.anchor: في الدين واتفاق الكلمة والعون والنصرة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r12.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r12.claim: They command faith, obedience, and good.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r13.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r13.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r13.claim: They forbid polytheism, disobedience, and whatever Islamic law does not recognize.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r13.anchor: وينهون عن المنكر} عن الشرك والمعصية وما لا يعرف في الشرع

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r14.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r14.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r14.claim: The prayer they establish is the obligatory prayer.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r15.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r15.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r15.claim: Believers give alms and obey God and His Messenger; God will show them mercy, for He is mighty and wise.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v4p72#2/r15.anchor: ويؤتون الزكاة ويطيعون الله ورسوله أولئك سيرحمهم الله إن الله عزيز حكيم

BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r1.claim: Believers’ mutual guardianship contrasts with the hypocrites’ mutual affiliation in the preceding verse.
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r1.anchor: في مقابلة قوله المنافقون والمنافقات بعضهم من بعض

BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r2.claim: Believers promote right, oppose wrong, pray, give alms, and obey God and His Messenger in all other matters.
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r2.anchor: ويطيعون الله ورسوله } في سائر الأمور

BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r3.claim: The future particle sīn emphasizes that God’s mercy for them will certainly occur.
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r3.anchor: لا محالة فإن السين مؤكدة للوقوع

BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:9:71/r4.claim: God is sovereign over everything and nothing He wills can resist Him; He is wise, placing things where they belong.

BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r11.claim: The believers’ mutual alliance and their commands to good, rejection of wrong, prayer, almsgiving, and obedience stand as the faithful pattern beside the warning about earlier disbelieving peoples.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r11.anchor: والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أوليآء بعض يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر ويقيمون الصلاة

BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r12.claim: The faithful are promised God’s mercy, while His might and wisdom ground the promise.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p356/r12.anchor: أولئك سيرحمهم الله إن الله عزيز حكيم

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r8.claim: After describing the hypocrites' mutual allegiance and threatening those like them with destruction for persisting without reflection, he turns to believers to invite repentance through hope in their state.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r8.anchor: عطف ببيان حال المؤمنين ترغبيا في التوبة طعما في مثل حالهم

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r9.claim: Unlike the hypocrites' 'some of them are of others,' the believers are allies without imitation or caprice: each follows the Messenger by conclusive proof, according to individual understanding, showing sound and rooted faith.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r9.anchor: ولم يقل : من , كما قال في المنافقين : من { بعض } دلالة على أن أحدا منهم لم يقلد أحدا

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r10.claim: Their alliance means they stand together against outsiders like one body, whose other members respond with fever and wakefulness when one organ suffers.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r10.anchor: كالجسد الواحد إذا اشتكى منه عضو تداعى له سائر الجسد بالحمى والسهر

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r11.claim: Maʿrūf is everything recognized and permitted by the revealed law.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r11.anchor: وهو كل ما عرفه الشرع وأجازه

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r12.claim: They likewise forbid wrong, showing no favoritism to anyone.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r12.anchor: { وينهون } أي كذلك { عن المنكر } لا يحابون أحدا

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r13.claim: They perform prayer with all its pillars, conditions, and limits, mindful of their Lord and drawing aid from it for whatever befalls them.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r13.anchor: يوجدونها على صفة تقتضي قيامها بجميع أركانها وشروطها وحدودها مراقبة لربهم

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r14.claim: Zakat is support for their poor, joining service to fellow creatures to service of the Creator; it contrasts with the hypocrites' withholding hands (9:67).
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r14.anchor: مواساة منهم لفقرائهم صلة للخلائق بعد خدمة الخالق

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r15.claim: Their obedience to God and His Messenger signals their good conduct and gracious companionship.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r15.anchor: إشارة إلى حسن سيرتهم وجميل عشرتهم

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r16.claim: The promised mercy parallels the hypocrites' being forgotten after forgetting God (9:67).
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r16.anchor: وهذا مع الجملة قبله مواز لقوله في المنافقين { نسوا الله فنسيهم }

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r17.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r17.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r17.claim: The road is rough and difficult, so the traveler depends on God's mercy, which is gracious treatment after forgiveness; no one can cross or arrive without it.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r17.anchor: فالسائر مضطر إلى الرحمة , وهي المعاملة بعد الغفران بالإكرام

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r18.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r18.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r18.claim: God's invincible power lets Him aid His party and grant mercy without anyone preventing it; His wisdom makes His decree impossible to undo.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r18.anchor: فهو قادر على نصر من يوالي حزبه وأن ينيله من ثمرات الرحمة ما يريد

BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r19.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r19.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r19.claim: Believers remain victorious over every corrupter while they preserve mutual loyalty and its accompanying virtues.
BIQAI-FULL:v3p357/r19.anchor: أن المؤمنين لا يزالون منصوورين على كل مفسد ما داموا على هذه الخلال

DURR-FULL:v4p233/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r5.speaker: الضحاك
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r5.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says believers call people to faith in God and His Messenger, spending in God's cause and obeying Him, and forbid association and unbelief; enjoining good and forbidding wrong is a duty God imposed on believers.
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r5.anchor: عن الضحاك في قوله {والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض يأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر} يدعون إلى الإيمان بالله ورسوله والنفقات في سبيل الله وما كان من طاعة الله

DURR-FULL:v4p233/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says their alliance is brotherhood in God: they love one another for God's sake, and their loyalty is for God.
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r6.anchor: عن ابن عباس {والمؤمنون والمؤمنات بعضهم أولياء بعض} قال: اخاؤهم في الله يتحابون بجلال الله والولاية لله

DURR-FULL:v4p233/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r7.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r7.claim: Salman transmits the Prophet's saying that people known for good in this world are people of good in the next, and people of evil here are people of evil there; a parallel mursal version is from Abū ʿUthmān.
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r7.anchor: عن سلمان قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أهل المعروف في الدنيا أهل المعروف في الآخرة وأهل المنكر في الدنيا أهل المنكر في الآخرة

DURR-FULL:v4p233/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r8.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r8.claim: Abū Mūsā transmits a Prophetic report portraying good and evil as two beings raised on Judgment Day: good gives its people glad tidings, while evil drives its companions to cling to it.
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r8.anchor: عن أبي موسى أن نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: إن المعروف والمنكر خليقتان ينصبان يوم القيامة فأما المعروف فيبشر أهله ويعدهم الخير

DURR-FULL:v4p233/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r9.speaker: سعيد بن المسيب
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r9.claim: Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib attributes to the Prophet the saying that after faith, the chief of reason is treating people considerately, and that no one is ruined after consultation; he repeats the saying about good and evil people in both lives.
DURR-FULL:v4p233/r9.anchor: عن سعيد بن المسيب قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رأس العقل بعد الإيمان بالله مداراة الناس ولن يهلك رجل بعد مشورة وأهل المعروف في الدنيا

IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r1.speaker: النضر بن شميل
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r1.claim: Al-Nadr ibn Shumayl explains a believer as one secure from God's punishment.
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r1.anchor: سمعت النضر بن شميل يقول : تفسير المؤمن : انه امن من عذاب الله

IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r2.claim: The Prophet says the Emigrants and Helpers are allies in this world and the next, as are Quraysh's freedmen and the people of Thaqif.
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r2.anchor: عن عبد الرحمن بن هلال العبس عن جرير بن عبد الله قال : سمعت النبي - صلى الله عليه وسلم - يقول : المهاجرون والانصار بعضهم اولياء بعض

IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r3.speaker: قتادة
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r3.claim: Qatada describes believers as those who keep beseeching God night and day until He answers them.
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r3.anchor: عن قتادة قال : المؤمنون : هم العجاجون بالليل والنهار والله ما زالوا يقولون : ربنا ربنا حتى استجيب لهم

IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r4.speaker: مقاتل بن حيان
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r4.claim: Muqatil says they command obedience to their Lord and forbid disobedience to Him.
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r4.anchor: عن مقاتل بن حيان قوله : يامرون بالمعروف قال : يامرون بطاعة ربهم وينهون عن المنكر قال : وينهون عن معصيته

IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r5.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r5.speaker: عطاء
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r5.claim: Ata says obeying the Messenger means following the Book and the Sunna.
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r5.anchor: عن عطاء في قوله : اطيعوا الله واطيعوا الرسول قال : طاعة الرسول : اتباع الكتاب والسنة

IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r6.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r6.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r6.claim: Abu al-Aliyah says God is mighty in His punishment when He punishes and wise in His command.
IBNABIHATIM:v6p1838#2/r6.anchor: عن أبي العالية في قوله : عزيز حكيم يقول : عزيز في نقمته اذا انتقم حكيم في امره

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r1.claim: This clause answers 9:67 and identifies the people who receive pardon as those attached to the believers; its sentence continues the linked sequence of clauses.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r1.anchor: هذه تقابل قوله : { المنافقون والمنافقات بعضهم من بعض } ( التوبة : 67 ) لبيان أن الطائفة التي ينالها العفو

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r2.claim: Believers share the bond of Islamic allegiance as equals; its sense conveys sincerity and mutual support, unlike hypocrites who seem to arise from one another in vices.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r2.anchor: اللحمة الجامعة بينهم هي ولاية الإسلام ، فهم فيها على السواء ليس واحد منهم مقلدا للآخر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p262/r3.claim: The added description of believers as establishing prayer honors prayer as the greatest form of enjoining what is right.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r1.claim: Giving alms by believers contrasts with the hypocrites' withholding their hands.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r1.anchor: ويؤتون الزكاة } مقابل قوله في المنافقين { ويقبضون أيديهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r2.claim: Obedience to God and His Messenger contrasts with the hypocrites' forgetting God, since obedience entails attentiveness to the one obeyed.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r2.anchor: لأن الطاعة تقتضي مراقبة المطاع فهي ضد النسيان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r3.claim: The promise that God will show mercy to believers counters the statement that He forgot the hypocrites.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r3.anchor: سيرحمهم الله } مقابل قوله في المنافقين { فنسيهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r4.claim: The future particle reinforces the certainty of coming mercy; with a present verb it conveys what قد conveys with a past verb, as in 93:5.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r4.anchor: والسين لتأكيد حصول الرحمة في المستقبل ، فحرف الاستقبال يفيد مع المضارع

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r5.claim: The demonstrative signals that the people described are worthy of what follows because of the qualities listed before it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r5.anchor: صاروا أحرياء به من أجلل الأوصاف المذكورة قبل اسم الإشارة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r6.claim: God's might enables Him to benefit His allies, and His wisdom places reward with those who deserve it; this explains His mercy.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v10p263/r6.anchor: أنه تعالى لعزته ينفع أولياءه وأنه لحكمته يضع الجزاء لمستحقه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r12.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r12.claim: After warning hypocrites with deterrents from hypocrisy, the passage turns to believers’ traits that invite faith, as a kindness to God’s servants.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r12.anchor: ولما فرغ من ذكر المنافقين بالأشياء التي ينبغي أن تصرف عن النفاق وتنهى عنه عقب ذلك بذكر المؤمنين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r13.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r13.claim: Their mutual guardianship is specifically for God; hypocrites have no guardianship, intercession, or mutual prayers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r13.anchor: وذكرت هنا «الولاية» إذ لا ولاية بين المنافقين لا شفاعة لهم ولا يدعو بعضهم لبعض

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r14.claim: Enjoining what is right means worshipping and affirming God’s unity, together with what follows from that.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r14.anchor: وقوله بالمعروف يريد بعبادة الله وتوحيده وكل ما اتبع ذلك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r15.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r15.claim: Forbidding wrong means rejecting idol worship and whatever follows from it.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r15.anchor: وقوله عن المنكر يريد عن عبادة الأوثان وكل ما اتبع ذلك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r16.speaker: أبو العالية
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r16.claim: Abū al-ʿĀliya says Quranic commands to right call people from associationism to Islam, and prohibitions of wrong forbid worship of idols and devils.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r16.anchor: عن أبي العالية أنه قال كل ما ذكر الله في القرآن من الأمر بالمعروف فهو دعاء من الشرك إلى الإسلام

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r17.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r17.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r17.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the prayer established here as the five daily prayers.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p57#2/r17.anchor: وقال ابن عباس في قوله ويقيمون الصلاة هي الصلوات الخمس

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r1.claim: If zakat means the obligatory due, praising voluntary almsgiving is more emphatic, since one who keeps voluntary gifts is likelier to fulfill the obligation.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r1.anchor: وبحسب هذا تكون الزكاة المفروضة، والمدح عندي بالنوافل أبلغ، إذ من يقيم النوافل أحرى بإقامة الفرض

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r2.claim: Obedience to God and His messenger encompasses recommended acts.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r2.anchor: وقوله ويطيعون الله ورسوله جامع للمندوبات

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r3.claim: The future particle sīn delays the promised mercy so souls may savor hope, while God’s bounty guarantees fulfillment.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v3p58/r3.anchor: والسين في قوله سيرحمهم مدخلة في الوعد مهلة لتكون النفوس تنعم برجائه، وفضله تعالى زعيم بالإنجاز

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p468#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p468#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p468#2/r1.claim: Believers support one another as a single body: they enjoin faith and forbid unbelief.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v3p468#2/r1.anchor: أي بعضهم يوالي بعضا فهم يد واحدة يأمرون بالإيمان وينهون عن الكفر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r1.claim: Believing men and women are mutual allies who support and strengthen one another.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r2.claim: A sound hadith compares one believer strengthening another to interlocking fingers.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r2.anchor: كما جاء في الصحيح: "المؤمن للمؤمن كالبنان

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r3.claim: Another sound hadith compares believers' affection and mercy to one body whose members share pain through fever and sleeplessness.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r3.anchor: وفي الصحيح أيضا: "مثل المؤمنين في توادهم وتراحمهم، كمثل الجسد الواحد، إذا اشتكى منه عضو تداعى له سائر الجسد بالحمى والسهر"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r4.claim: The believers' duty to enjoin right and forbid wrong is also stated in 3:104.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r4.anchor: ولتكن منكم أمة يدعون إلى الخير ويأمرون بالمعروف وينهون عن المنكر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r5.claim: Establishing prayer and giving zakah express obedience to God and kindness toward His creation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r5.anchor: أي: يطيعون الله ويحسنون إلى خلقه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r6.claim: Obeying God and His Messenger means doing what they command and leaving what they prohibit.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r6.anchor: أي: فيما أمر، وترك ما عنه زجر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r7.claim: God will show mercy to those who possess these qualities.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r7.anchor: أي: سيرحم الله من اتصف بهذه الصفات

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r8.claim: God is mighty: He honors whoever obeys Him, and dignity belongs to God, His Messenger, and believers; He is wise in assigning these traits and the hypocrites' contrasting traits, as in 63:8.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v4p174#3/r8.anchor: أي: عزيز، من أطاعه أعزه، فإن العزة لله ولرسوله وللمؤمنين، {حكيم} في قسمته هذه الصفات لهؤلاء

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r1.claim: Muwālāh means mutual support, from closeness: one is near another through support; a believer is God’s ally because God supports him.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r1.anchor: الموالاة: التناصر، وأصله من الولي، وهو القرب، كأنه يليه بالنصرة،

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r10.claim: The description of believers follows the hypocrites’ traits and rewards as their opposite.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r10.anchor: لما تقدم ذكر المنافقين وخصالهم عقبه بذكر المؤمنين وخصالهم وما أعد لهم،

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r11.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r11.claim: One explanation is that believers support and are loyal to one another in religion, the Islam that joins them.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r11.anchor: قيل: بعضهم أولياء بعض في الدين، وهو الإسلام الذي يجمعهم،

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r12.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r12.claim: Another explanation takes their mutual alliance as love and affection.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r12.anchor: وقيل: بعضهم يوالي بعضا بمعنى. المحبة والمودة

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r13.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r13.claim: One view glosses the recognized good as faith and acts of obedience, and the rejected wrong as unbelief and sins because reason and revealed law reject them.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r13.anchor: قيل: الإيمان والطاعات وينهون عن المنكر عن الكفر والمعاصي؛ لأن العقل والشرع ينكره،

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r14.speaker: أبو العالية والأصم
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r14.claim: Abu al-Aliya and al-Asamm identify the good as faith and the wrong as associating partners with God, opposite the hypocrites’ conduct.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r14.anchor: وقيل: المعروف الإيمان، والمنكر الشرك، عن أبي العالية، والأصم، بخلاف ما يفعله المنافقون

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r15.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r15.claim: They perform the obligatory prayer, which hypocrites perform only for show.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r15.anchor: ويقيمون الصلاة أي: يؤدون الصلاة المفروضة التي لا يأتيها المنافقون إلا رياء

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r16.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r16.claim: They give the alms that the hypocrite withholds out of stinginess.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r16.anchor: ويؤتون الزكاة أي يعطونها إذا بخل بها المنافق

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r17.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r17.claim: They obey God and His Messenger in what they command and prohibit, unlike the hypocrites.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r17.anchor: ويطيعون الله ورسوله فيما يأمر وينهى، بخلاف المنافق

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r18.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r18.claim: Those described will receive mercy on Judgment Day by entering Paradise and being rewarded there, while hypocrites are punished in Hell.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r18.anchor: أولئك يعني: من تقدم وصفهم سيرحمهم الله يوم القيامة

JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r19.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r19.claim: God is mighty, able both to show mercy and to punish, and wise in placing each person where they belong.
JISHUMI:v5p3193#2/r19.anchor: إن الله عزيز قادر على الرحمة والعذاب حكيم يضع كل واحد موضعه.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r1.claim: The believers’ mutual alliance contrasts with the hypocrites’ being ‘some from some’ in 9:67.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r2.claim: The future particle assures that mercy will certainly come; as with a future threat, it means the addressee cannot escape even if it is delayed, as also in 19:96, 93:5, and 4:152.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r2.anchor: السين مفيدة وجود الرحمة لا محالة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r3.claim: ʿAzīz means overpowering all and able to reward or punish; ḥakīm means placing everything where it belongs according to its due.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p275#2/r3.anchor: غالب على كل شيء قادر عليه

MUQATIL:9:70-71/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r3.claim: The believing men and women are those who affirm God's oneness, including the Prophet's companions such as ʿAli b. Abi Talib.
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r3.anchor: يعنى المصدقين بتوحيد الله، { والمؤمنات } ، يعنى المصدقات بالتوحيد، يعنى أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

MUQATIL:9:70-71/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r4.claim: The believers are one another's allies in religion.

MUQATIL:9:70-71/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r5.claim: Enjoining right means faith in Muhammad; they also forbid wrong.
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r5.anchor: { يأمرون بالمعروف } ، يعنى الإيمان بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، { وينهون عن المنكر ويقيمون الصلاة }

MUQATIL:9:70-71/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r6.claim: Establishing prayer means completing the five daily prayers, and giving zakat means paying the alms.
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r6.anchor: { وينهون عن المنكر ويقيمون الصلاة } ، يعنى ويتمون الصلوات الخمس، { ويؤتون الزكاة } ، يعنى ويعطون الزكاة

MUQATIL:9:70-71/r7.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r7.speaker: author
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r7.claim: The believers obey God and His Messenger; God will show them mercy, is mighty in His dominion, and wise in His command.
MUQATIL:9:70-71/r7.anchor: { ويطيعون الله ورسوله أولئك سيرحمهم الله إن الله عزيز } فى ملكه، { حكيم } [آية: 71] فى أمره

NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r1.claim: Believing men and women are allies through mutual support and compassion.

NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r2.claim: They command obedience and faith and forbid idolatry and disobedience.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r2.anchor: بالطاعة و الإيمان ﴿ وينهون عن المنكر

NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r3.claim: The future marker guarantees the promised mercy, just as future wording can emphasize a threat.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r3.anchor: السين مفيدة وجود الرحمة لا محالة فهى تؤكد الوعد كما تؤكد الوعيد

NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r4.claim: God is mighty and able to grant reward or impose punishment.
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r4.anchor: عزيز ﴾ غالب على كل شيء قادر

NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v2p98#3/r5.claim: God is wise, placing everything in its proper place.

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r1.claim: Believing men and women are allies because their hearts are united in affection, love, and compassion.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r1.anchor: أي قلوبهم متحدة في التواد والتحاب والتعاطف

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r2.claim: Unlike believers, hypocrites are “of one another” because their hearts differ and they are only grouped together in judgment.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r2.anchor: وقال في المنافقين «بعضهم من بعض» لأن قلوبهم مختلفة ولكن يضم بعضهم إلى بعض في الحكم

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r3.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r3.claim: Enjoining right means worshipping and affirming God’s oneness, and what follows from that.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r3.anchor: أي بعبادة الله تعالى وتوحيده، وكل ما أتبع ذلك

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r4.claim: Forbidding wrong means prohibiting worship of idols and what follows from that.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r4.anchor: عن عبادة الأوثان وكل ما أتبع ذلك

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r5.speaker: أبو العالية
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r5.claim: Al-Ṭabarī transmits from Abū al-ʿĀliyah that Qurʾānic mentions of enjoining right and forbidding wrong mean forbidding worship of idols and devils.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r5.anchor: وذكر الطبري عن أبي العالية أنه قال: كل ما ذكر الله في القرآن

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r6.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says prayer here means the five prescribed prayers, making zakāt the obligatory alms.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r6.anchor: وقال ابن عباس: هي الصلوات الخمس، وبحسب هذا تكون الزكاة هنا المفروضة

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r7.speaker: ابن عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyyah says praise for voluntary prayers is more emphatic, since one who establishes them is more likely to establish obligations.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r7.anchor: ابن عطية: والمدح عندي بالنوافل أبلغ

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r8.claim: Obedience to God concerns obligations, and obedience to the Messenger concerns what he prescribed for them.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r8.anchor: في الفرائض { ورسوله } فيما سن لهم

QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r9.claim: The future sīn delays the promised mercy in expression so souls can savor anticipation of God’s favor, which He guarantees to fulfill.
QURTUBI-FULL:9:71/r9.anchor: والسين في قوله: { سيرحمهم الله } مدخلة في الوعد مهلة لتكون النفوس تتنعم برجائه

BURSEVI:v3p351/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351/r1.claim: A Persian couplet contrasts worldly sovereignty with the greater security of a poor person’s kingdom; the wise should reflect on worldly and afterlife conditions until death and burial.
BURSEVI:v3p351/r1.anchor: فقد تقرر حال أهل الدنيا وحال أهل الآخرة فالعاقل يعتبر ويتبصر إلى أن يموت ويقبر

BURSEVI:v3p351/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351/r2.claim: Believers share the true religion and monotheism, help each other in religious and worldly matters, and guide one another to higher degrees through spiritual training and purification.
BURSEVI:v3p351/r2.anchor: بعضهم على دين بعض في الحق ، أي متفقون في التوحيد وبعضهم معين بعض

BURSEVI:v3p351/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351/r3.claim: They enjoin every good, including faith and obedience, and encourage one another to seek God, the real good, as expressed in the saying I loved to be known.
BURSEVI:v3p351/r3.anchor: جنس المعروف الشامل لكل خير ومنه الإيمان والطاعة ويهيج بعضهم بعضا في طلب الله

BURSEVI:v3p351/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351/r4.claim: They forbid every evil, including disbelief and sins that sever a person from God in this world and beyond.
BURSEVI:v3p351/r4.anchor: جنس المنكر المنتظم لكل شر ومنه الكفر والمعاصي التي تقطع العبد عن الله

BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r1.claim: Establishing prayer means constant remembrance and vigilant, present hearts that trade cannot distract; these are people of unveiling and hearts, opposite to those who forgot God.
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r1.anchor: فلا يزالون يذكرون الله تعالى ويديمون مراقبة القلب وحضوره مع الله بحيث لا تلهيهم تجارة

BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r2.claim: Unlike hypocrites who withhold their hands, they pay obligatory zakat and give any surplus beyond necessary sufficiency, purifying themselves of worldly attachment.
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r2.anchor: فهم يؤدون الزكاة الواجبة بل ينفقون ما فضل عن كفافهم الضروري

BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r3.claim: They obey every command and prohibition, in contrast to hypocrites described by complete rebellion and departure from obedience.
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r3.anchor: في كل أمر ونهي وهو بمقابلة وصف المنافقين بكمال الفسق والخروج عن الطاعة

BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r4.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r4.claim: Najmiyya reads the qualities as sincerity: hypocrites may pray and give zakat outwardly, yet follow ego and desire for worldly interests instead of obeying God and His Messenger.
BURSEVI:v3p351#2/r4.anchor: قال في "التأويلات النجمية" : يشير إلى الإخلاص في معاملتهم

BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r1.claim: God will pour out mercy through support and victory, save them from Hell’s punishment and the pain of distance from Him, and admit them to Paradise and nearness.
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r1.anchor: يفيض عليهم آثار رحمته من التأييد والنصرة البتة وينجيهم من العذاب الأليم

BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r2.speaker: بعض أهل الإشارة
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r2.claim: Some people of inward interpretation describe mercy at five trials: death, the grave, receiving the record, the balance, and standing before God, easing each hardship and protecting the believer.
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r2.anchor: وعن بعض أهل الإشارة. {سيرحمهم الله} في خمسة مواضع عند الموت وسكراته

BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r3.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r3.claim: A hadith associates the five daily prayers with ease at death, in the grave, at Munkar and Nakir’s questioning, at the balance, and on the narrow bridge; no grading is stated.
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r3.anchor: وفي الحديث : "من صلى صلاة الفجر هان عليه الموت وغصته

BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r4.claim: God’s might explains His promise: He can honor His allies, subdue His enemies, and bestow favor on those who obey Him.
BURSEVI:v3p351#3/r4.anchor: تعليل الوعد ، أي : قوي قادر على إعزاز أوليائه

RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r1.claim: After describing hypocrites’ corrupt deeds and threatening them, the passage presents believers’ good qualities in opposition and then promises them lasting reward.
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r1.anchor: اعلم أنه تعالى لما بالغ في وصف المنافقين بالأعمال الفاسدة والأفعال الخبيثة

RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r2.claim: Hypocrites are “some from others” because followers’ hypocrisy grows from ancestral models, imitation, appetite, and habit; believers are “allies” because their bond comes through shared reasoning, divine guidance, and enabling grace.
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r2.anchor: بل بسبب المشاركة في الاستدلال والتوفيق والهداية

RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r3.claim: Wilāya is the opposite of enmity and its root sense is nearness; enmity is named from crossing beyond or away.

RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r4.claim: The five marks distinguishing believers from hypocrites are commanding right, forbidding wrong, prayer, zakat, and obedience: unlike hypocrites, believers do not command evil, pray lazily, withhold obligatory wealth, or shirk and discourage jihad.
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r4.anchor: فذكر هذه الأمور الخمسة التي بها يتميز المؤمن من المنافق

RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v16p104#2/r5.claim: The future particle sīn in “God will have mercy on them” emphasizes certainty and force, like a promise of eventual revenge; Rāzī compares other future promises.
